description: UiPath Studio 2026 — professional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) software for designing, developing, and managing automated business workflows. Features a visual workflow designer, desktop and web automation, Excel processing, API integration, document understanding, computer vision, and intelligent automation tools. Integrates with UiPath Robot and Orchestrator for attended and unattended automation, scheduling, execution, and centralized workflow management. Supports enterprise automation, AI-powered processes, and custom workflow development. Ideal for RPA developers, business analysts, automation engineers, and enterprise IT teams.
